reason: First honest recording. The previous ceiling was a frozen constant of 2 captured at v1.74 ship that nothing updated, so the suite had been permanently red while the real count drifted to 504 — an alarm nobody could silence, and one at least one agent read as release-blocking. This number is the studio's accumulated template/body-shape and memory-bound debt (independently measured by vela-v72 at 84/514/7380 the same afternoon; the small delta is that day's commits). It is NOT a release measurement: what ships is validated by the release harness at stage and walked by Po at the cold walk. | RAISED 504 -> 509 on 2026-08-08 at Mike's ruling during the v1.86 stage, verbatim: "I honestly do not care if there is an open file in an inbox. This is an example of overkill for doing a vault rebuild." The +5 delta was five HARD inbox violations (closed items parked in inboxes); four were re-parented, the count did not move, and the release was not going to wait on hygiene classes the principal does not value as release-blocking. Post-v1.86 batch item: the ratchet gates on a curated class list and prints the itemized delta when it refuses.
how_to_update: Pay debt down, re-run tropo-validate, lower this number, and say why in `reason`. Raising it requires a deliberate decision recorded here — a ceiling that rises quietly is the failure this file replaces.
